$description: Facts the shared chrome carries on every page. build-pages.js stamps them into the masthead, the menu sheet and the colophon; edit here, then run `npm run pages`. The season is the issue's own, set here and never read from the visitor's clock.
name: Ben Siverly

resume.$description: The public résumé: the page and the one PDF it offers by default.

contact.$description: The address stays base64-encoded in the markup, as on the home page, and is decoded only when someone presses Copy.

home.$description: What only the home colophon carries: the old home page's intro, its Elsewhere list and its Contact line, which live here now. note is one paragraph per entry; outside is the Outside work line, one item per entry, an item with an href becoming a link. The ids keep the old #elsewhere-heading and #contact-heading links landing.
note: I thrive in the unglamorous middle: the customer calls, the half-clean data, the code that has to actually run, the half-dug-up yard. That’s where the real work happens, long before the demo.

As a recovering data scientist, I still revel in the data, hunting for what customers want but can’t name yet. I’ve built my own things for years: an apparel company back when, and a string of side projects I cared about enough to finish.

I care about shipping things that actually work, staying close to my family, and building a few things that might outlast me. Proud future ancestor of the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma. Probably the most optimistic person you’ll meet.
outside: Native gardening in the Bay Area
Raising kids who are kind and grounded
home.contact: I’m always happy to talk about product, tools, or gardening.

consulting.$description: 05 Consulting, made from content/consulting/*.md by build-pages.js. It is a department of the issue (num), not a masthead link. On, every colophon carries a line to the front page (line), and the pages' front matter writes their block of sitemap.xml and their section of llms.txt, which summary opens.
consulting.name: Consulting
consulting.line: strategy and operations for small and mid-size companies and startups
consulting.summary: Ben takes on a few strategy and operations clients at a time: small and mid-size companies and startups, when something new (an AI model, an agent, a question their data could answer) might change how they run. Product management is one way he does the work. Each page is also published as plain Markdown.
